summary: Retested all iteration_1 fixes, tested the new premium full-cast voices, checked genre theming on desktop and mobile, and ran a core-flow regression. Backend: 43/43 pytest pass after updating 3 old tests whose expectations changed by design. Found and fixed one CRITICAL frontend bug: /play crashed on cold load because a useQuery hook was called after an early return (Rules of Hooks). Every requested fix (a-i) is verified. Full cast works end to end in the UI (cast selects, PATCH persists across reload, read aloud plays from /voice, second call cached at 0.1s). Seen once: a transient object-storage 500 on the cast voice endpoint.

minor.issue: Seen once: the object storage PUT (put_object) returned 500 (integrations objstore HTTPError), and the endpoint returned a raw 500 Internal Server Error. A retry succeeded. put_object and db.files insert are not wrapped in try/except. Return 502 with a friendly message, and consider a retry.
The 409 check uses lock.locked(), and _set_event_image takes the same lock briefly. An act that lands while a paint result is being written gets a spurious 409. Low impact.
The engine value is not validated. Unknown engines are treated as openai silently.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. useQuery(['voices']) was declared after the `if (isError)`/`if (!pt)` early returns, which changed the hook order. React threw 'change in the order of Hooks', and /play/:pid never rendered (gameplay-control-panel missing). Moved the hook above the early returns.

issues: The feed has no fixed height on mobile, so the composer (y≈2128px) sits below the whole narrative. Consider a sticky composer or a capped feed height. The order is right (feed and composer come first).
fmtDate shows 'Night 4 · dawn' and 'Night 3 night', which reads oddly. Consider 'Day 4 · dawn' or 'The 4th night'.

action_items: Wrap put_object/db.files.insert in cast_voice (and _store_png callers) in try/except, and return 502 instead of a raw 500 when object storage fails
Optional: avoid the spurious 409 by using a separate lock for image writes (or an act-in-progress flag instead of lock.locked())
Optional: make the mobile composer sticky. Rename the Eldoria date label 'Night N'
critical_code_review_comments: Play.jsx hooks after early return (fixed). Watch for the same pattern in other pages.
server.py is 828 lines. Split it into routers (auth, play, saves, voice, store).

act still $sets the whole state. It is now safe only because _set_event_image shares the in-process asyncio lock. This breaks with more than one uvicorn worker. Use targeted $set/$push or an optimistic clock check for multi-worker safety.
_to_jpeg also re-encodes user-uploaded PNG portraits, which drops transparency. Acceptable, but note it.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows pass after the Play.jsx hook fix)

rca of the issue: Play crash: Play.jsx declared `const { data: voices } = useQuery(...)` after `if (!pt) return ...`. On the first render pt is undefined, so the hook is skipped; on the next render it runs, which changes the hook count and crashes React. Mitigation: all hooks before conditional returns (applied).
